mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with increased costs and reduced output.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% annualized, it signals a tightening monetary policy with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2% does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with strong consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing by more than 2% annualized, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increase > 2% does not correlate with positive returns.
